title: Does an SRS document need a defined set of strata? (2026-11-27)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
here's a thought.

Does an srs document need to define a set of layers?

I want a human to be able to view the minutes and then drill down. But the current experiences of drilling down feel difficult. Once we drill we have a graph or a mess.

What if we actually created a defined set of strata?
